description: Browse GFW and Resource Watch datasets, inspect dataset metadata and fields, and pull GLAD alerts or alert statistics for an area.

aggregateBy.description: Time bucket used by statistics mode.
aggregateBy.title: Group statistics by

alertSystem.description: Alert layer used by alerts and statistics. Integrated alerts are newer; GLAD coverage on the public tables extends through 2021 for most countries.
alertSystem.title: Alert system

application.description: Filter the Resource Watch catalog by source application. In GFW catalog mode it matches dataset tags, names and IDs.
application.title: Application

area.description: Alerts and statistics area: ISO3 country code (BRA), ISO3:ADM1 (BRA:15), ISO3:ADM1:ADM2 (BRA:15:139), a Resource Watch geostore ID, or a latitude,longitude pair (for example -7.1,-54.9).
area.title: Area (ISO3, admin code, geostore or lat,lng)

connectorType.description: Filter Resource Watch catalog datasets by connector type.
connectorType.title: Connector type

dataset.description: GFW Data API dataset slug used by datasetFields (for example umd_tree_cover_loss, gfw_integrated_alerts).
dataset.title: GFW dataset slug

datasetIds.description: Dataset references for datasetDetails. Accepts Resource Watch UUIDs, GFW Data API slugs and dataset API URLs.
datasetIds.title: Dataset IDs, slugs or API URLs

endDate.description: Alert period end in YYYY-MM-DD format.
endDate.title: End date

gladConfirmOnly.description: Keep only alerts with confidence 3 or higher.
gladConfirmOnly.title: Confirmed alerts only

maxItems.description: Maximum records to return (1-1000). For statistics this caps the number of time buckets.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Choose what to fetch. Catalog modes need no keys; alert modes use the public GFW Data API alert summary tables.
mode.title: Mode

polygon.description: Optional GeoJSON Geometry, Feature or FeatureCollection. Overrides Area and is converted to a geostore automatically.
polygon.title: Custom GeoJSON polygon

provider.description: Filter Resource Watch catalog datasets by data provider.
provider.title: Provider

radiusKm.description: Radius used to build an area when Area is a latitude,longitude pair.
radiusKm.title: Point radius (km)

searchQuery.description: Free-text filter for catalog modes. Every word must appear in the name, description, tags, version or ID.
searchQuery.title: Search query

startDate.description: Alert period start in YYYY-MM-DD format.
startDate.title: Start date

version.description: GFW dataset version for datasetFields. Use latest or a version such as v1.9.1.
version.title: Dataset version

title: Global Forest Watch & Resource Watch Explorer Input
